description: CMU ARPABET -> IPA mapping for L2-ARCTIC phone labels. Values are POWSM phone tokens WITHOUT slashes; a space-separated value is split into multiple POWSM tokens (1-to-many). Diphthongs are split into vowel + glide and r-coloured vowels into vowel + /ɹ/ to match the proven Turkish pipeline target space (turkish_lora_util.DEFAULT_PHONE_ALIASES) so the shared eval/diff code behaves identically and every target token stays inside POWSM's vocabulary.
stress_note: Lookup tries the full token first (e.g. 'AH0'), then strips a trailing stress digit (AH0/AH1/AH2 -> AH). 'AH0' is special-cased to schwa /ə/; all other AH -> /ʌ/. If the corpus phones tier carries no stress digits, every AH collapses to /ʌ/ and the schwa distinction is lost — the prep audit (raw_arpabet_counts) reveals whether digits are present.
